sql.title: ER entity DATASET_NEURON (view in schema er)
ER entity CONNECTION: one neuron's strongest edges
sql.sql:
SELECT from_neuron_id, to_neuron_id, synapse_count, valid_from, valid_to
FROM er.connection
WHERE from_neuron_id = (SELECT canonical_neuron_id FROM er.canonical_neuron
                        WHERE name = 'hemibrain:1688868386')
ORDER BY synapse_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

sql.title: All tables with their live row counts
sql.sql:
SELECT relname AS table_name, n_live_tup AS rows
FROM pg_stat_user_tables
WHERE schemaname = 'cc'
ORDER BY n_live_tup DESC;

sql.title: JOIN + materialized view: neurons and connections per release
sql.sql:
SELECT d.name AS dataset, r.version_label AS release, s.neurons, s.connections
FROM release r
JOIN dataset d USING (dataset_id)
JOIN release_stats s USING (release_id)
ORDER BY d.dataset_id, r.release_order;

sql.title: GROUP BY / HAVING: most common cell types in the latest hemibrain release
sql.sql:
SELECT a.annotation_value AS cell_type, count(*) AS neurons
FROM annotation a
JOIN dataset_neuron dn USING (dataset_neuron_id)
WHERE dn.dataset_id = (SELECT dataset_id FROM dataset WHERE code = 'hemibrain')
  AND a.annotation_key = 'cell_type'
  AND upper_inf(a.valid_rel)   -- still valid in the newest release
  AND upper_inf(a.tx)          -- current belief
GROUP BY a.annotation_value
HAVING count(*) >= 50
ORDER BY neurons DESC
LIMIT 15;

sql.title: 4-table JOIN: one neuron's strongest partners in v1.2, with their cell types and regions
sql.sql:
SELECT partner.source_neuron_id AS partner, t.annotation_value AS partner_cell_type,
       er.primary_region(partner.dataset_neuron_id) AS partner_region, c.synapse_count
FROM connection c
JOIN release r ON r.dataset_id = c.dataset_id AND r.version_label = 'v1.2'
JOIN dataset_neuron partner ON partner.dataset_neuron_id = c.post_neuron_id
LEFT JOIN annotation t ON t.dataset_neuron_id = partner.dataset_neuron_id
                      AND t.annotation_key = 'cell_type'
                      AND t.valid_rel @> r.release_order AND upper_inf(t.tx)
WHERE c.pre_neuron_id = find_neuron('hemibrain', '1688868386')
  AND c.valid_rel @> r.release_order AND upper_inf(c.tx)
ORDER BY c.synapse_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

sql.title: Every constraint on the connection table (from the system catalog)
sql.sql:
SELECT conname AS constraint_name,
       CASE contype WHEN 'p' THEN 'PRIMARY KEY' WHEN 'f' THEN 'FOREIGN KEY' WHEN 'u' THEN 'UNIQUE'
                    WHEN 'c' THEN 'CHECK' WHEN 'x' THEN 'EXCLUDE' END AS type,
       pg_get_constraintdef(oid) AS definition
FROM pg_constraint
WHERE conrelid = 'cc.connection'::regclass
ORDER BY contype;

sql.title: How many constraints of each kind the schema has
sql.sql:
SELECT CASE contype WHEN 'p' THEN 'PRIMARY KEY' WHEN 'f' THEN 'FOREIGN KEY' WHEN 'u' THEN 'UNIQUE'
                    WHEN 'c' THEN 'CHECK' WHEN 'x' THEN 'EXCLUDE' END AS type,
       count(*) AS constraints
FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.connamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'cc'
GROUP BY contype
ORDER BY constraints DESC;

sql.title: The append-only trigger and the tables it protects
Valid time: one neuron's state in every release
sql.sql:
SELECT r.version_label AS release, n.present, n.annotations ->> 'cell_type' AS cell_type,
       n.annotations ->> 'instance' AS instance
FROM release r
JOIN dataset d USING (dataset_id),
     LATERAL neuron_at_release(find_neuron('hemibrain', '1688868386'), r.release_id) n
WHERE d.code = 'hemibrain'
ORDER BY r.release_order;

sql.title: Bitemporal history: valid in which releases + when the database recorded it
Neurons whose cell type changed between releases
sql.sql:
SELECT dn.source_neuron_id, a1.annotation_value AS old_type, a2.annotation_value AS new_type,
       release_label(dn.dataset_id, lower(a2.valid_rel)) AS changed_in
FROM annotation a1
JOIN annotation a2 ON a2.dataset_neuron_id = a1.dataset_neuron_id
                  AND a2.annotation_key = a1.annotation_key
                  AND lower(a2.valid_rel) = upper(a1.valid_rel)   -- a2 starts where a1 ends
JOIN dataset_neuron dn ON dn.dataset_neuron_id = a1.dataset_neuron_id
WHERE a1.annotation_key = 'cell_type' AND upper_inf(a1.tx) AND upper_inf(a2.tx)
  AND a1.annotation_value <> a2.annotation_value
LIMIT 20;

sql.title: Delta storage: rows stored vs one full copy per release
sql.sql:
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM connection)        AS connection_rows_stored,
       (SELECT sum(connections) FROM release_stats) AS rows_if_every_release_were_a_full_copy;

sql.title: Atomic loads: failed runs left no facts behind
sql.sql:
SELECT ir.run_id, d.code AS dataset, r.version_label AS release, ir.status,
       left(ir.error_message, 70) AS error,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM provenance p WHERE p.ingestion_run_id = ir.run_id) AS facts_recorded
FROM ingestion_run ir
JOIN release r USING (release_id) JOIN dataset d USING (dataset_id)
ORDER BY ir.run_id;

sql.title: This console's own transaction: read-only, as role cc_reader
sql.sql:
SELECT current_user,
       current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS read_only,
       current_setting('statement_timeout')    AS timeout,
       current_setting('transaction_isolation') AS isolation_level;

sql.title: EXPLAIN ANALYZE: B-tree index lookup (fast)
sql.sql:
SELECT * FROM connection
WHERE pre_neuron_id = find_neuron('hemibrain', '1688868386') AND upper_inf(tx);

sql.title: EXPLAIN: range query served by the GiST index
EXPLAIN: no index on synapse_count, so a full scan
sql.sql: SELECT * FROM connection WHERE synapse_count = 4321;

sql.title: All indexes: type (B-tree / GiST) and size
sql.sql:
SELECT tablename, indexname, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(format('cc.%I', indexname)::regclass)) AS size,
       indexdef
FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'cc'
ORDER BY pg_relation_size(format('cc.%I', indexname)::regclass) DESC;

sql.title: Views and materialized views in the database
sql.sql:
SELECT schemaname AS schema, viewname AS name, 'view' AS kind FROM pg_views WHERE schemaname IN ('cc', 'er')
UNION ALL
SELECT schemaname, matviewname, 'materialized view' FROM pg_matviews WHERE schemaname = 'cc'
ORDER BY kind, schema, name;

sql.title: Stored functions written for the project (SQL and PL/pgSQL)
sql.sql:
SELECT n.nspname AS schema, p.proname AS function, pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS arguments,
       l.lanname AS language
FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid = p.prolang
WHERE n.nspname IN ('cc', 'er')
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_depend d WHERE d.objid = p.oid AND d.deptype = 'e')
ORDER BY 1, 2;

sql.title: View: where one neuron makes its synapses (brain regions, v1.2)
sql.sql:
SELECT l.code, l.name, s.pre_synapses, s.post_synapses
FROM neuron_region_synapses s
JOIN brain_region_label l USING (brain_region_id)
JOIN release r USING (release_id)
WHERE s.dataset_neuron_id = find_neuron('hemibrain', '1688868386') AND r.version_label = 'v1.2'
ORDER BY s.pre_synapses + s.post_synapses DESC;

sql.title: Lineage of one fact back to file, line and pipeline run
sql.sql:
SELECT jsonb_pretty(trace_provenance('connection', c.connection_id)) AS lineage
FROM connection c
WHERE c.pre_neuron_id = find_neuron('hemibrain', '1688868386')
ORDER BY c.synapse_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

sql.title: Source files recorded with their SHA-256 checksums
sql.sql:
SELECT d.code AS dataset, r.version_label AS release, coalesce(f.member_path, f.archive_path) AS file,
       f.row_count, left(f.sha256, 16) || '…' AS sha256
FROM source_file f JOIN release r USING (release_id) JOIN dataset d USING (dataset_id)
ORDER BY d.dataset_id, r.release_order;

sql.title: ConnectomeDiff runs and what each found
sql.sql:
SELECT dr.diff_run_id, ra.version_label AS from_release, rb.version_label AS to_release,
       dr.stats
FROM diff_run dr
JOIN release ra ON ra.release_id = dr.release_a
JOIN release rb ON rb.release_id = dr.release_b
WHERE dr.status = 'succeeded'
ORDER BY dr.diff_run_id;

sql.title: Largest synapse-weight changes, hemibrain v1.0 → v1.1
sql.sql:
SELECT neuron_source_id AS pre, post_source_id AS post, old_weight, new_weight, weight_delta
FROM diff_event_detail
WHERE diff_run_id = (SELECT max(dr.diff_run_id) FROM diff_run dr
                     JOIN release a ON a.release_id = dr.release_a AND a.version_label = 'v1.0'
                     JOIN release b ON b.release_id = dr.release_b AND b.version_label = 'v1.1')
  AND entity_type = 'connection' AND change_type = 'modified'
ORDER BY abs(weight_delta) DESC
LIMIT 10;

sql.title: Entity resolution: mapping status by method
sql.sql:
SELECT method, review_status, count(*) AS mappings, round(avg(confidence), 3) AS avg_confidence
FROM neuron_mapping
GROUP BY method, review_status
ORDER BY method, review_status;

sql.title: The PostgreSQL side of the cross-store link (key of the MongoDB document)
Every MongoDB sync is recorded in PostgreSQL
sql.sql:
SELECT d.code AS dataset, r.version_label AS release, s.status, s.documents_written, s.records_written,
       s.finished_at - s.started_at AS duration
FROM metadata_sync s JOIN release r USING (release_id) JOIN dataset d USING (dataset_id)
ORDER BY s.metadata_sync_id;

sql.title: Fragments on each shard, per strategy (verified copies)
sql.sql:
SELECT p.code AS strategy, d.shard_id, d.neurons AS owned_neurons, d.connections AS owned_rows,
       d.mirrors, pg_size_pretty(d.bytes_on_shard) AS size, d.verified
FROM shard_deployment d JOIN partition_strategy p USING (strategy_id)
WHERE d.deployment_id IN (SELECT max(deployment_id) FROM shard_deployment GROUP BY strategy_id, shard_id)
ORDER BY p.strategy_id, d.shard_id;

sql.title: Query log: shards touched and latency for each routed query
sql.sql:
SELECT coalesce(p.code, '-') AS strategy, q.query_kind, q.parameters ->> 'target' AS target,
       count(*) AS runs, round(avg(q.shards_touched), 2) AS avg_shards,
       round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY q.latency_ms)::numeric, 2) AS p50_ms
FROM query_execution q LEFT JOIN partition_strategy p USING (strategy_id)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 2, 3;
